in_sanskrit.name: गोर्खा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: गोर्क्ष (Gorksh) - गोर (Gor) meaning 'Cow' and क्ष (Ksh) meaning 'Lord of'. This name is derived from the ancient Gorkha Kingdom in Nepal, where the local deity was believed to be the Lord of Cows.

in_hindi.name: गोर्खा
in_hindi.long_meaning: गोरखा (Gorkhā) - गोर (Gor) meaning 'Cow' and खा (Khā) meaning 'Protector'. This name is derived from the ancient Gorkha Kingdom in Nepal.

in_marathi.name: Gorkha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Mountain dweller, warrior
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gorkha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the name of the ancient kingdom Gorkha in Nepal, which was known for its brave warriors and its location in the mountainous region. The name Gorkha signifies a person who embodies courage, strength, and the spirit of adventure, as well as someone who is capable of providing protection to those around them.
